messages:
Samir Rao: Hey folks — thinking of putting together an office softball team for the summer league. Who's interested?
Alex Kim: I am! Weeknights are best for me — can do Tue/Thu. :baseball:
Priya Patel: Count me in, but only weekends — weekdays are tight for me.
Marcus Chen: I'm game. Happy to pitch in for equipment/field booking.
Olivia Park: Love it! I can help with social posts and snacks for first game. :hotdog:
Alex Kim: Quick poll? https://poll.example.com/softball-times — can everyone add preferences
Samir Rao: Thanks Alex — also would anyone be willing to captain/organize practices? No experience required.
Marcus Chen: I can captain. Been on a rec team before.
Priya Patel: Nominate Marcus :thumbsup:
Olivia Park: Any ideas on team name? "Redwood Runners"? "Latency Sluggers"? :thinking_face:
Alex Kim: "Latency Sluggers" is perfect 😂
TeamBot: Reminder scheduled: signups close in 5 days — add your availability to the poll. [autoschedule message]
Samir Rao: Awesome — next steps: fill poll, Marcus will confirm field by Monday, I'll send calendar invite once we have a day.
Priya Patel: Sounds good — thanks everyone!
Olivia Park: Wheee! Looking forward to it :tada:
